caveats: Descriptors depend on resolution, depth and how the cutout was made. Compare images only when they were made the same way.
No morphological class and no redshift is assigned.
Asymmetry has the expected noise contribution removed; very faint sources can still read as asymmetric.
The source reaches close to the image edge, so its light is partly cut off.
